verdict.rationale: Browserbase supports observing browser sessions (browserbase-docs-1) and explicitly offers agents that 'click through your product continuously and alert you the moment something breaks' (browserbase-docs-11), which covers basic failure alerting for scraping/monitoring jobs. However, there is no evidence of structured job performance dashboards, metrics, or explicit data-quality validation tooling for extracted data. Missing for 10: dedicated job performance monitoring/metrics dashboard, data quality validation checks, and integration with alerting channels (email/Slack/webhooks) beyond a generic marketing claim.
